you_rank.note: 3 originals in the last 48h (best 173 views, the Ragebait post), below the 5K bar. Three fresh drafts below ride today's top formats.

drafts.draft_en:
This is the future of ad review in 1 image

1) AI makes the creative
2) AI checks it against your brand rules, legal claims, and platform policy
3) A human only sees what came back FIX or BLOCK

Your review queue shrinks 90%. Your risk doesn't go up.
drafts.video_tip: Single still image, not a video: a 3-box flow (Make, Check, Human) with the middle box showing APPROVE / FIX / BLOCK stamps and a tiny review queue at the end. If you do video, 10s slow zoom across the three boxes while you read the list.

drafts.draft_en:
Strange feeling: finding out an ad you loved last week was 100% AI. The voice, the faces, the product shots.

I build in this space and I couldn't tell.

The top 1% of AI creative is already indistinguishable. Which is exactly why brands need to check claims, rights, and disclosure before it ships, not after.
drafts.video_tip: 20s vertical. Play 5s of a polished ad, freeze, then reveal labels popping up on each element ('AI voice', 'AI face', 'AI product shot'). Cut to you: 'I couldn't tell either.' End on a checklist overlay: claims, rights, disclosure.

drafts.draft_en:
Agents are making ads faster than any human can review them.

So the reviewer has to be an agent too.
drafts.video_tip: 8s. Fast montage of ad variants flooding the screen, one tired human reviewer in the corner. Hard cut to black with the second line as on-screen text. No music under the last line.
